subject.title: fix(mattermost): backfill thread history from server when in-memory window is empty

question: Should the Mattermost monitor synchronously await one bounded, fail-open thread-history request on the first cold turn of each stored thread session to restore context?
rationale: Tests can establish bounds and correctness, but only the Mattermost owner can accept the deliberate first-turn latency and timeout policy on the inbound path.

options.title: Accept bounded cold-turn recovery
options.body: Rebase and land the current stored-session design after confirming its timeout and live behavior on the exact head.

options.title: Require a different latency policy
options.body: Keep the PR open and revise the inbound recovery strategy if the current synchronous timeout is too costly for supported Mattermost deployments.

options.title: Pause server-side recovery
options.body: Close or defer the PR if preserving current inbound latency is more important than recovering thread context after restart or session reset.

recommendation.title: Accept bounded cold-turn recovery
recommendation.body: Rebase and land the current stored-session design after confirming its timeout and live behavior on the exact head.

likelyOwner.reason: The repository explicitly identifies this handle with Mattermost ownership, making them the best available decision owner for inbound latency and recovery semantics.
